feature: Social Media Strategy Audit for selfrules.org
workflow_rationale: This is a strategic deliverable task that follows the pattern: research → analysis → deliverable creation → validation. While not code implementation, it produces structured artifacts (audit report, content calendar, engagement playbook) that require systematic development and verification.

phases.name: Discovery & Data Collection
phases.description: Gather comprehensive data about selfrules.org website structure, current social media presence, and integration points between site and social channels

subtasks.description: Analyze website structure and social integration points

deliverable.name: Website Analysis Notes
deliverable.content: Document site sections, CTAs, social links, booking flows, and content themes

verification.instructions: Confirm analysis covers: Hero section value prop, Journey timeline, Work Together CTAs, social footer links, blog integration points

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive WEBSITE_ANALYSIS_NOTES.md covering: Hero value prop, Journey timeline, WorkTogether CTAs, Footer social links, Blog integration points, Open Graph metadata, Analytics integration, and bilingual strategy. Identified key gaps including no social sharing buttons, Twitter handle inconsistency, and no OG images.

subtasks.description: Research current social media presence across all platforms

deliverable.name: Social Presence Inventory
deliverable.content: List all identified social accounts with URLs, activity status, follower counts, posting frequency

verification.instructions: Confirm all major platforms checked: LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive SOCIAL_PRESENCE_INVENTORY.md documenting all major platforms: LinkedIn (verified active), Twitter/X (uncertain - handle inconsistency @Matt_Selfrules vs @mattiadluca), GitHub (active - 1 follower, 10 repos), Instagram (not found), YouTube (not found), TikTok (not found), Facebook (not found). Also checked emerging platforms Bluesky and Threads (no presence). Key finding: LinkedIn is only active B2B platform. Twitter handle inconsistency needs resolution.

subtasks.description: Analyze target audience profile from website positioning

deliverable.name: Target Audience Profile
deliverable.content: Document: B2B professional services audience, PM professionals, decision-makers, Italian/English demographics

verification.instructions: Confirm profile includes: job roles, industry sectors, geographic scope, language preferences, pain points

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive TARGET_AUDIENCE_PROFILE.md documenting: 4 target segments (Decision-Makers, Product Teams, Aspiring PMs, Recruiters), job roles, industry sectors (B2B SaaS, Enterprise Software, Platform/Integration, POS/Payments), geographic scope (Italy primary, EU secondary, Global remote tertiary), language preferences (70% Italian, 30% English), and detailed pain points mapped from website positioning. Includes Ideal Customer Profiles for each service offering with budget ranges.

phases.name: Platform Scoring & Analysis
phases.description: Apply Platform Selection Scorecard and REACH metrics framework to evaluate each platform's fit for the target audience and business goals

subtasks.description: Apply Platform Selection Scorecard to all candidate platforms

deliverable.name: Platform Scorecard Results
deliverable.content: Scored evaluation for each platform using formula: (Audience×2 + Content + Gap + Resources + Alignment) / 7

scoring_criteria.Audience Presence: Weight 2x - Are ideal B2B customers actively using this platform?
scoring_criteria.Content Fit: Weight 1x - Does thought leadership style work here?
scoring_criteria.Competitive Gap: Weight 1x - Is there room to stand out vs. other PMs?
scoring_criteria.Resource Match: Weight 1x - Can solo practitioner consistently create required content?
scoring_criteria.Business Alignment: Weight 1x - Does platform support consultation/booking conversions?

verification.instructions: Verify all 5 platforms scored with values 1-10 for each criterion, with weighted calculation applied

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive PLATFORM_SCORECARD_RESULTS.md with all 5 platforms (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok) scored using weighted formula: (Audience×2 + Content + Gap + Resources + Alignment) / 7. Results: LinkedIn 9.0 (Primary), Twitter/X 6.4 (Secondary), YouTube 4.7, Instagram 4.1, TikTok 2.7. All platforms below 7.0 threshold marked for deprioritization. Includes detailed rationale, visual score chart, and strategic recommendations.

subtasks.description: Identify primary platform recommendation with data-driven rationale

deliverable.name: Platform Recommendation
deliverable.content: Clear #1 platform identified (expected: LinkedIn) with score breakdown and strategic rationale

subtasks.expected_outcome: LinkedIn as primary (B2B fit), Twitter/X as secondary (tech/PM community), others deprioritized

verification.instructions: Verify recommendation includes: score comparison table, rationale for #1 choice, secondary platform consideration

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive PLATFORM_RECOMMENDATION.md with: (1) Score comparison table showing LinkedIn 9.0 vs Twitter/X 6.4 vs YouTube 4.7 vs Instagram 4.1 vs TikTok 2.7, (2) Detailed 5-factor rationale for LinkedIn as #1 choice (Audience Fit 10/10, Content Format 9/10, Conversion Path 9/10, Resource Sustainability 9/10, Competitive Gap 8/10), (3) Secondary platform consideration for Twitter/X with conditional factors (must resolve handle inconsistency first), (4) Deprioritization guidance for other platforms, (5) Implementation roadmap phases 1-3.

deliverable.name: Integration Assessment
deliverable.content: Evaluate Site→Social (how website drives social engagement) and Social→Site (how social drives website traffic/conversions)

site_to_social: Social sharing buttons on blog posts
social_to_site: Content repurposing from site to social

verification.instructions: Confirm bidirectional flow documented with gaps identified and improvement recommendations

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive INTEGRATION_ASSESSMENT.md documenting bidirectional website-social integration. Key findings: Site→Social scored 3/10 (critical gaps: no OG images, Twitter handle mismatch, no sharing buttons), Social→Site scored 5/10 (moderate gaps: LinkedIn Featured not used, no content repurposing workflow). Overall integration health: 4/10. Identified 12 improvement actions across 3 priority tiers. Quick wins: Fix Twitter handle (5 min), add OG images (1 hr), update LinkedIn Featured section (15 min). Estimated improvement from 4/10 to 7/10 with 4-5 hours of focused implementation.

phases.name: Strategy Development
phases.description: Develop content strategy, posting cadence, and community engagement framework using TRIBE model

subtasks.description: Define content mix using 4-1-1 rule adaptation

deliverable.name: Content Mix Strategy
deliverable.content: Platform-specific content distribution: 60% value posts, 25% engagement posts, 15% promotional posts

verification.instructions: Verify content pillars defined for each category with percentage allocation matching 4-1-1 rule

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive CONTENT_MIX_STRATEGY.md with 12 content pillars across 3 categories following 4-1-1 rule adaptation. Value posts (60%): 4 pillars covering PM Methodology, Lessons Learned, Business-Tech Translation, Agile Advice. Engagement posts (25%): 4 pillars covering Questions, Polls, Discussion Starters, Experience Sharing. Promotional posts (15%): 4 pillars covering Consultation Availability, Service Offerings, Booking CTAs, Blog Promotion. Includes platform-specific adaptations for LinkedIn (primary) and Twitter/X (secondary), bilingual content strategy (70/30 Italian/English on LinkedIn, 50/50 on Twitter), example post ideas per pillar, and weekly/monthly calendar templates.

subtasks.description: Create sustainable posting cadence for solo practitioner

deliverable.name: Posting Cadence Recommendations
deliverable.content: Platform-specific frequency that balances impact with sustainable effort for a solo practitioner

verification.instructions: Verify cadence is realistic for solo practitioner with time estimate per week

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive POSTING_CADENCE_RECOMMENDATIONS.md with: (1) Total time budget of 3.5 hrs/week for solo practitioner, (2) LinkedIn 3-4 posts/week on Mon/Wed/Thu (+Fri optional) at 7:30-8:30 AM or 12-1 PM CET, (3) Twitter/X 1-2 posts/week repurposed content (conditional), (4) Bilingual strategy 70/30 IT/EN on LinkedIn, 50/50 on Twitter, (5) Content batching workflow with monthly planning + weekly writing sessions, (6) Tool recommendations for efficiency, (7) Realistic expectations for Month 1 and Month 3, (8) Adjustment triggers for busy periods, (9) 3-phase scalability roadmap.

subtasks.description: Apply TRIBE model for community building strategy

deliverable.name: Community Engagement Playbook
deliverable.content: 5-phase TRIBE framework with specific tactics for each phase

tribe_phases.Target: Define ideal community member (PM professionals, aspiring PMs, tech leaders)
tribe_phases.Recruit: Valuable content + strategic engagement in PM communities/groups
tribe_phases.Invest: Exclusive insights, recognition of commenters, accessible expertise
tribe_phases.Bond: Create connections between followers, facilitate discussions
tribe_phases.Empower: Feature community content, encourage testimonials and referrals

verification.instructions: Verify all 5 TRIBE phases have specific, actionable tactics listed

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive TRIBE_COMMUNITY_STRATEGY.md with 30 actionable tactics across all 5 TRIBE phases: TARGET (5 tactics - persona profiling, identification signals, exclusion criteria), RECRUIT (6 tactics - value-first commenting, PM group participation, strategic connections), INVEST (6 tactics - <2hr reply commitment, recognition shout-outs, VIP DM follow-ups), BOND (6 tactics - connector comments, cross-member introductions, weekly rituals), EMPOWER (7 tactics - content challenges, UGC features, testimonial generation, ambassador cultivation). Includes 3 detailed community personas mapped to service offerings, anti-vanity metrics focus, 3-month implementation timeline.

subtasks.description: Define REACH metrics and KPIs per platform

deliverable.name: KPI Framework
deliverable.content: Platform-specific metrics focusing on community quality over vanity metrics

reach_metrics.Conversion: Profile visits, website clicks, booking inquiries
reach_metrics.Holding: Dwell time, return visitors, follower retention

anti_vanity_metrics: Follower count alone is NOT a success metric

verification.instructions: Verify all 5 REACH metrics defined with specific targets and measurement methods

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive REACH_KPI_FRAMEWORK.md with all 5 REACH metrics (Reach, Engagement, Amplification, Conversion, Holding) defined with: (1) Platform-specific metrics for LinkedIn (primary) and Twitter/X (secondary), (2) Target benchmarks for Month 1, 3, and 6 with rationale, (3) Measurement methods and tracking tools, (4) Comment quality scoring rubric (1-5 scale), (5) Conversion funnel mapping with percentages, (6) Return commenter tracking system, (7) UTM parameter standards, (8) Consolidated KPI dashboard template, (9) Anti-vanity metrics commitment throughout. Total: 850+ lines of actionable KPIs focusing on community quality over vanity metrics.

phases.name: 30-Day Content Calendar Creation

deliverable.name: Calendar Days 1-14
deliverable.content: Daily content plan with: date, platform, content type, topic, format, language, time to post

subtasks.week_theme: Foundation - Establishing voice and content rhythm

verification.instructions: Verify 14 days covered with at least 3-4 LinkedIn posts per week, proper content mix distribution

deliverable.name: Calendar Days 15-30
deliverable.content: Daily content plan with: date, platform, content type, topic, format, language, time to post

subtasks.week_theme: Expansion - Building engagement and community response

verification.instructions: Verify days 15-30 covered, includes engagement posts and community interaction opportunities

subtasks.description: Add content hooks and format templates to calendar

deliverable.name: Content Templates
deliverable.content: Platform-specific hook formulas and post format templates

linkedin_hooks: I made a [mistake] so you don't have to

verification.instructions: Verify calendar entries include hook formulas and formatting guidance

verification.instructions: Verify report follows skill output format with all required sections, quantified scores, and actionable recommendations

deliverable.format: Markdown table with: Week, Day, Date, Platform, Type (Value/Engagement/Promo), Topic, Format, Language, Best Time
